start: Android phone, Settings > Rest timer and sounds, 'Workout sounds' on, sound 'MettleUp chime'

user_sees: 'The sound when your rest is over. The MettleUp chime is the default.'
must_not: A sheet with no current choice marked

user_sees: The bell plays at media volume
'Bell' is marked; the sheet stays open
must_not: The sheet closes before the member can hear the others

steps.action: Close the sheet, tick a set, lock the phone, wait for the rest to end
user_sees: 'Rest is over' rings with the bell
must_not: The chime or the phone's default tone plays

start: Sound 'Whistle' chosen, MettleUp open on screen during a rest

steps.action: Wait for the rest to end with the app on screen
user_sees: The whistle plays once at notification volume
must_not: A different sound than with the screen off

user_sees: Footnote 'Workout sounds are off, so Rest is over only buzzes. Turn them on to hear this sound.'

steps.action: Tap 'Double beep', close, finish a rest
user_sees: The double beep plays once as a preview
must_not: The double beep at the end of the rest while sounds are off
The whistle still rings at the next rest

steps.action: Finish a rest with the phone locked
must_not: Two sound channels left side by side in Android settings for old choices
